chunks: Say: "Are you trying to convince God of your faithfulness? But God knows all there is in the heavens and the earth, for God has knowledge of everything."
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Are you teaching God about your religion?'
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a critique of the People of the Book who claimed their religion was the only true one, implying that God needed their validation. It underscores the divine attribute of 'Alim' (All-Knowing) to highlight that God's knowledge is intrinsic and not dependent on human testimony, reinforcing the concept of divine omniscience in contrast to human limited understanding.
